items.title: 5G and COVID-19: A Systematic Review of the Evidence
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory widely debunked by scientific experts and international organizations.

items.title: 5G and COVID-19: UN agency debunks 'hoax' theory
items.snippet_en: The International Telecommunications Union (ITU), a UN agency, confirmed in April 2020 that 5G is not responsible for the spread of COVID-19, calling the theory "a hoax that has no technical basis."

items.title: DHS to advise telecom firms on preventing 5G cell tower attacks linked to coronavirus conspiracy theories
items.snippet_en: Viruses cannot travel on radio waves or mobile networks, and COVID-19 has spread in many countries without 5G. Experts state it is physically impossible for electromagnetic fields to transfer viruses. There is no scientific evidence 5G compromises the immune system.

items.title: Clearing up myths: 5G and coronavirus
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory that has been widely debunked. This theory led to dozens of arson attacks on 5G towers in 2020.

items.title: 5G and COVID-19 conspiracy theories
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory widely debunked. There is no scientific evidence 5G compromises the immune system. This theory led to arson attacks on 5G towers.

items.title: 5G and coronavirus (COVID-19)
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory widely debunked. Viruses cannot travel on radio waves. The UK government has actively dispelled the myth, stating there is no link.

items.title: Daily COVID-19 Brief, Issue 62
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory widely debunked. Viruses cannot travel on mobile networks. Organizations like the WHO and FEMA have actively dispelled the myth.

items.title: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) myths
items.snippet_en: The claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus is a conspiracy theory widely debunked. Viruses cannot travel on mobile networks.

items.title: 5G misinformation
items.snippet_en: There is no scientific evidence to suggest that 5G compromises the immune system or enables people to get sick from COVID-19.
